name: StepFun Vision
description: Registers StepFun models (step-5-preview and step-3.7-flash for Step Plan / token-plan users, step-1o-turbo-vision for standard API users) as image & video understanding providers via the OpenAI Responses API.

surface.description: StepFun subscription surface. plan (default) = Step Plan / token-plan users, step-5-preview is the default model (step-3.7-flash recommended as fallback). api = standard pay-per-use API users, step-1o-turbo-vision is preferred. All surfaces call the OpenAI Responses API (/responses).

defaultPrompt.description: Prompt sent to the model alongside each media attachment. Overrides the plugin default.

maxTokens.description: max_tokens for chat completions. step-3.7-flash performs reasoning, so keep this >= 1024.

imageDetail.description: Image detail level for image_url blocks (OpenAI-compatible). Default: high.
